title: Extension Mechanism
text: setStarvation() sets three pieces one call: Passing starv_coef = 0 reverses change: removes "starvation" entry other_mort, removes starv_coef column species_params, removes "mizerStarvation" params@extensions. projection, time step species size class, mizer calls starvMort(): getMort() calls other_mort function params, n, n_pp, n_other, t component name, rate function accept ... absorb arguments use. Note t named explicitly forwarded, starvation mortality computed time rest mortality models whose rates depend time. function: Calls standard mizer function getEReproAndGrowth() get energy available growth reproduction, \(E_r(w)\), current community state. Computes starvation mortality rate \[\mu_s(w) = \frac{-E_r(w)}{w} \times \texttt{starv\_coef}\] size classes energy balance negative (\(E_r < 0\)). Sets mortality zero size classes positive energy balance. result species--size matrix dimensions initialN(params), getMort() adds mortality terms.
code: params <- setStarvation(params, starv_coef = 10) starvMort <- function(params, n, n_pp, n_other, t = 0, ...) {     e <- getEReproAndGrowth(params, n = n, n_pp = n_pp, n_other = n_other,                             t = t)     starv_coef <- species_params(params)[["starv_coef"]]     mu_s <- -t(t(e * starv_coef) / params@w)     mu_s[e > 0] <- 0     mu_s }

title: mizerStarvation 0.2.0
text: Updated conventions mizer 3.3.0, now minimum required version. setStarvation() now records extension params object mizer::recordExtension() instead copying whole session-wide chain returned getRegisteredExtensions() extensions slot. slot therefore lists extensions actually applied model, entry carries installation requirement version mizerStarvation model conforms . Code reading params@extensions[["mizerStarvation"]] now gets named character vector requirement version entries rather bare requirement string. setStarvation() writes starv_coef given_species_params<-() recorded user input, validates upgrades argument validParams() rather calling validObject(). starvMort() getStarvMort() gained explicit t argument, passed getEReproAndGrowth(). Previously time silently dropped, starvation mortality evaluated t = 0 models time-dependent rates. Bug fix: getStarvMort() ignored n, n_pp n_other arguments given always used initial values stored params object. now uses abundances passed . Calls relied defaults unaffected.
